rules.rule: One accent (butter) CTA per page, maximum.
rules.why: Rarity keeps the accent meaningful; frequency erodes salience (Philosophy §2).

rules.rule: Butter is never a surface. Allowed only for: the accent CTA, the Studio glyph/square in the mark, hover underlines, focus rings, text selection.
Petrol marks the Loy layer only (founder monograms, Loy tags).
rules.why: Two colors with different jobs must never do the same job (§2).

rules.rule: Signal teal only where something is computing or AI-generated. Never decoration.
rules.why: Signal is Petrol given voltage, reserved for the Lab's live states.

rules.rule: Text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1). Concrete, butter, ochre and signal are never text on paper. Use ink-2 for secondary text, brick-deep for errors on paper-alt, signal-ink for Signal text.
No raw hex or arbitrary color classes in app code. Tokens only.
Solid circle = Loy, solid square = Studio, hollow triangle = Lab. These shapes mean nothing else.
rules.why: Kandinsky's shape logic, mapped to the studio's three real bodies of work (§1.2).

rules.rule: No circular or triangular UI chrome: square avatars (except founders), square radios, linear loaders instead of ring spinners, no pie or donut charts.
Status icons are square-framed (StatusIcon). Never lucide CircleCheck, AlertTriangle, Info or XCircle.
Radius 0 everywhere.
rules.why: A rounded corner softens an edge that has no reason to be soft (§1.1).

rules.rule: Meaningful boundaries are 2px ink (or the surface's line color). The rule color #D8D2C2 is for decorative inner dividers only.
No shadows. Overlays use a 2px border and an ink scrim.
rules.why: A shadow implies a light source that does not exist (§1.1).

rules.rule: No gradients (including skeleton shimmer).
rules.why: Ambiguous depth cues cost reading effort (§3).

rules.rule: Base-8 spacing. Use Stack/Cluster/Grid gap steps; half-steps (4px, 12px) only in tight UI.
Jost for display and headings, Archivo for body and UI. No other families.
rules.why: A working revival of a working revival (§1.4).

rules.rule: Heading levels are semantic and sequential (one h1, no skips). Visual size is a separate prop.
rules.why: Structure for screen readers; looks are independent.

rules.rule: Fonts load via <link> in index.html with preconnect, never CSS @import.
Use the fluid type scale (display, h1, h2, h3, lead, body, small, eyebrow, label). No ad-hoc font sizes for headings.
AA contrast for all text and UI boundaries.
Visible focus: butter ring hugging the element plus an ink (or paper) outline. Never remove focus styles.
rules.why: Butter alone is 1.55:1 on paper; the outline carries the contrast.

rules.rule: Everything works with a keyboard; icon-only controls have labels.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Every control has a visible label; errors are linked with aria-describedby; focus moves to the first invalid field, the error alert or the success heading.
Skip link, landmarks (header, main, footer, nav labels) and a unique document title on every page.
Touch targets at least 44px.
Every image has alt text; alt="" only when purely decorative.
Motion explains (assembly, state change, reveal). It never decorates or loops, except the Signal computing indicator.
CSS only, durations 150/250/550ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1). No framer-motion.
Reveals are fail-safe: content is visible unless an IntersectionObserver has proven it runs.
All UI copy in English.
No em dashes. Use periods, commas or colons.
rules.why: Reads as machine-written to our audience.

rules.rule: No superlatives or hype (best, leading, revolutionary, cutting-edge, seamless, world-class, game-changing).
No stats as flex, no invented numbers.
Real assets over recreations: real screenshots, real quotes, real clients only.
Copy lives in a data file (src/data/content.js), not inside components.

intents.intent: Start a new app or add the library to an existing one
Page frame with header, footer, skip link
Numbered section heading (01 What we do)
The single most important call to action on the page
A self-contained item (a case, a person)
Mark work as Studio or Lab, people as Loy
Facts about a project (client, year, status)
Choose one of 2 to 4 options with hints
Inline note or warning in content
Nothing to show yet / failed to load / 404

items.name: foundation
items.title: Foundation
items.purpose: Tokens, global base styles, surfaces, focus ring, type classes and motion for every LoyStudioLab app. Install first.
useWhen: Always, once per app, before any other @lsl item.

dontUseWhen.use: Their own UI. This library is LoyStudioLab-only.

a11y: Dual focus ring on every focusable element: butter ring plus ink (or paper) outline.
All animation and transition collapses under prefers-reduced-motion.
setup: tailwind.config.js is replaced by a short config that loads the preset (pass --overwrite). Delete any tailwind.config.cjs (older Base44 templates): Tailwind would otherwise read only one of them. Re-add app-specific theme.extend entries.
Add the font <link> from `fontLink` to index.html <head> with preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com (rule T3). Remove any CSS @import of fonts.
Keep src/index.css to the three @tailwind directives; delete the stock shadcn :root and .dark variable blocks (the preset defines them).
Wrap page bands in a surface: <Section surface="paper|alt|ink"> or className="surface-ink".
Base44 template: replace the ring spinner in App.jsx (and auth pages) with <LinearLoader>; mount <AccentBudget /> next to <ScrollToTop />.

Existing app: run `node scripts/lsl-doctor.mjs src --write-baseline` once so template code you did not write is recorded; later runs report only new findings. Commit lsl-doctor.baseline.json. Never re-baseline to hide your own findings.

classes.name: surface-paper | surface-alt | surface-ink
classes.purpose: Set colors for everything inside. Components follow automatically.

classes.name: eyebrow, label-caps, lead
classes.purpose: Section labels, UI labels, intro paragraphs.

classes.name: Tailwind colors
classes.purpose: Contextual: surface, fg, fg-2, line, divider, danger, loy, signal-fg, tint. Fixed: paper, paper-alt, ink, ink-2, butter, petrol, brick, brick-deep, ochre, concrete, rule, signal, signal-ink.

items.name: doctor
items.title: lsl-doctor
items.purpose: Checks an app against the LoyStudioLab rules and reports violations by rule ID. Run it before you finish any UI task.
useWhen: After building or changing UI in any app that uses the library.
In CI for apps that use the library.
a11y: Static checks only. Still run axe and a keyboard pass.
items.example:
node scripts/lsl-doctor.mjs src                  # human-readable
node scripts/lsl-doctor.mjs src --json           # for agents
node scripts/lsl-doctor.mjs src --write-baseline # once, when adopting the library in an existing app

items.name: accent-budget

props.name: max
props.description: Allowed accent CTAs per page.

useWhen: Mount once near the app root, next to the router.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.purpose: Trigger an action, or style a link as a button with asChild.

props.name: variant
props.description: accent = the page's one highest-priority CTA (C1). default = solid, follows the surface. outline = secondary. ghost = tertiary. destructive = delete or remove.

props.name: size
props.description: All sizes are at least 44px tall (A7).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child (e.g. a router <Link>) with button styles.

useWhen: Any action: submit, open, save, start.
Primary page CTA: variant="accent", once per page.
A link that should look like a button: asChild around <Link>.

dontUseWhen.case: A second accent on the same page

a11y: Busy state: set disabled and aria-busy while sending.
Label is the visible text; keep it a verb phrase ("Send message").
items.example:
<Button variant="accent" size="lg">Send message</Button>
<Button variant="outline">See the work</Button>
<Button asChild><Link to="/contact">Contact</Link></Button>

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.purpose: Single-line text entry. Always inside a Field.

props.name: type
props.description: Native input type. Use type, inputMode and autoComplete for good mobile keyboards.

useWhen: Names, emails, short answers.
a11y: Wrap in Field so label, hint and error are wired.
aria-invalid turns the border to the danger color.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.purpose: Multi-line text entry. Always inside a Field; pass maxLength and count to Field for a counter.
useWhen: Messages, descriptions, notes.
a11y: Field links the character count with aria-describedby.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.purpose: Uppercase UI label for a control. Field renders it for you.
useWhen: Only when building a control outside Field.
a11y: Always set htmlFor.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.purpose: Choose one option from a list of five or more.

props.name: position
props.description: Radix positioning mode.

useWhen: Five or more options, or options that do not need explanation.

dontUseWhen.case: Two to four options with hints

a11y: Wrap <Select> in Field: SelectTrigger reads the Field's id and aria wiring through FieldContext, so the label and errors apply.
items.example:
<Field label="Topic">
  <Select onValueChange={setTopic}>
    <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="Choose a topic" /></SelectTrigger>
    <SelectContent>
      <SelectItem value="web">Website</SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="app">App or internal tool</SelectItem>
    </SelectContent>
  </Select>
</Field>

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.purpose: A yes or no choice, or several independent choices.
useWhen: Consent, opt-ins, multi-select lists.
a11y: Pair with a <Label htmlFor> next to it; the label is the click target.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.purpose: One choice from a short list, as square radios (circles mean Loy, rule S2).
useWhen: Compact one-of-many choice in dense forms.

dontUseWhen.case: Two to four options that need hints

a11y: Give the group aria-labelledby pointing at a visible legend.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.purpose: Turn a setting on or off, applied immediately.
useWhen: Settings that take effect at once.

dontUseWhen.case: A choice submitted with a form

a11y: Needs a label via <Label htmlFor> or aria-label.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.purpose: A short uppercase tag: category, count, state.

props.name: variant
props.description: signal is only for AI or computing states (C4).

useWhen: Categories, short states, counts.
a11y: Text must carry the meaning; color is never the only cue.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.purpose: A flat 2px-ruled container for one item: a case, a person, a setting group.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading level; keep levels sequential (T2).

useWhen: Separate, clickable or self-contained items.

dontUseWhen.case: A set of parallel items in one block

a11y: If the whole card is a link, put the <a> on the title and stretch it (after:absolute after:inset-0).
items.example:
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Oslo Skatehall</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>An operations system for a community-run skatepark.</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
</Card>

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.purpose: A panel that slides in from an edge: mobile menu, filters, details.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

useWhen: Mobile navigation (SiteHeader uses it).
Secondary panels that keep the page visible behind them.
a11y: Always render a SheetTitle (visually hidden is fine). Focus is trapped and Escape closes.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.purpose: A 2px rule between regions.

props.name: tone
props.description: subtle is decoration only (G2).

useWhen: Between groups in a panel or list.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toaster
items.purpose: Short, transient confirmation messages (toast). Mount <Toaster /> once.
useWhen: Confirming a background action: saved, copied, sent.
a11y: Toasts disappear: never put the only copy of important information in one.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.purpose: Placeholder block while content loads. Pulses opacity, no shimmer.
useWhen: Content with a known shape that loads in under a few seconds.
a11y: Hidden from screen readers; announce loading elsewhere (aria-busy on the region).

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.purpose: A short hint on hover or focus for an icon or abbreviation.
useWhen: Naming an icon-only control (in addition to its aria-label).

dontUseWhen.case: Information people need to finish a task

a11y: Not reachable on touch: never the only place for important text.

props.description: Error message; sets aria-invalid.

props.description: Adds * and aria-required.

props.description: Adds "(optional)".

props.description: Current length, for the counter.

props.description: Shows a counter.

props.description: Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.

props.description: Field name; spread register(name) on it.

Form-level errors (FormAlert) and success (FormSuccess).

dontUseWhen.case: Bare Input with a placeholder as the label

a11y: On submit errors, focus the first invalid field (react-hook-form shouldFocusError does this).
On server errors, focus the FormAlert. Keep the user's text.
Error copy says what to do: "Please add your email, so we can reply."
items.example:
<form noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="flex flex-col gap-7">
  {failed && <FormAlert ref={alertRef} title="Your message was not sent.">Your text is still here. Try again, or email us.</FormAlert>}
  <Field label="Name" required error={errors.name?.message}>
    <Input autoComplete="name" {...register("name")} />
  </Field>
  <Honeypot {...register("website")} />
</form>

items.name: radio-tiles

With react-hook-form, use a Controller.

<Controller name="reason" control={control} render={({ field }) => (
  <RadioTiles legend="What is this about?" required error={errors.reason?.message}
    value={field.value} onValueChange={field.onChange} onBlur={field.onBlur}
    options={[{ value: "New project", hint: "You have something to build." }, { value: "Collaboration" }, { value: "General question" }]} />
)} />

props.name: items
props.description: id = section on the home page; href = another page.

props.description: Shown as a default (ink) button. Never accent: the page's accent CTA lives in the content (C1).

props.description: Show the marks legend in the mobile menu.

props.description: Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.

<SiteHeader

  cta={{ label: "Contact", href: "/#contact", id: "contact" }}
/>

items.purpose: Small display patterns: parallel items with a top rule, term/detail lists, workflow status, square avatars.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading element.

props.name: bar
props.description: Rule color. Values cards may use the muted palette; never butter (C2).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.

props.description: Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.

props.description: ai is only for AI-generated content (C4).

props.description: Override the label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.

props.name: name
props.description: Alt text and initials source.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.

useWhen: Services or values in a row (TopRuleCard).
Case facts (MetaList).
Lists of things with a state (StatusBadge).
People in products (Avatar).
a11y: StatusBadge always shows text; the icon is decorative.
items.example:
<TopRuleCard title="Digitalization">One real system instead of spreadsheets, chat threads and paper.</TopRuleCard>
<MetaList items={[{ term: "Client", detail: "Oslo Skateboardforening" }, { term: "Status", detail: "In use" }]} />
<StatusBadge status="done" />

items.name: status-icon
items.title: StatusIcon
items.purpose: Square-framed status marks: info, success, warning, error, pending.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, only when the icon stands alone.

props.description: Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.

useWhen: Anywhere a status needs a mark.
a11y: Decorative by default; meaning must also be in text.

useWhen: Persistent notes in content (Callout).
Uploads and long loads (LinearLoader).
First use and no-results (EmptyState); failed loads (ErrorState); 404 routes (NotFound).
a11y: ErrorState has role="alert".
LinearLoader is a labelled progressbar.
items.example:
<Callout tone="warning" title="Prices exclude VAT">We add 25% MVA on the invoice.</Callout>
<LinearLoader value={60} label="Uploading receipt" />
<EmptyState title="No receipts yet" action={<Button>Add a receipt</Button>}>Photos of receipts you add will show up here.</EmptyState>

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal, Rise
items.purpose: The two motion primitives: a fail-safe scroll reveal and a one-time hero entrance. CSS only.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered element.

props.name: delay
props.description: Stagger siblings by 0.06 to 0.1s.

props.description: Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.

props.description: Rendered element.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for spacing or placement only. Never colors, radius or shadows.

useWhen: Section content as it scrolls in (Reveal).
Hero text on load (Rise).

items.name: section-nav
items.title: useGoToSection, useActiveSection
items.purpose: In-page navigation: smooth jump that moves focus to the section heading, and active-section tracking for the header.

props.name: enabled
props.description: False on pages where the targets are not rendered.

useWhen: One-page sites with section links.
a11y: Respects reduced motion (instant jump).
items.example: const go = useGoToSection() go("work", e)}>Work

items.name: use-document-title
items.title: useDocumentTitle
items.purpose: Sets the browser title as "Page · LoyStudioLab".
useWhen: Every routed page.
a11y: Unique titles help screen-reader and tab users.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.purpose: True when the user asked for reduced motion; updates live.
useWhen: JS-driven motion (scrolling, timed changes).

dontUseWhen.use: Nothing: the preset already disables them

items.name: field-context
items.title: FieldContext
items.purpose: Lets Field pass its id and aria wiring to controls nested deeper than its direct child (SelectTrigger).
useWhen: Building a new control that should work inside Field without being its direct child.
a11y: Spread the context value onto the focusable element.

items.name: format
items.title: formatNOK, formatNumber, formatDate
items.purpose: Money, number and date formatting: English copy, Norwegian conventions (2 500 kr, 1 234,5, 11.11.2026).
useWhen: Any amount or date shown to people.
